استظرفنا (form X)
# اِسْتَظْرَفْنَا (istaẓrafnā) /is.taðˤ.raf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَظْرَفَ (istaẓrafa)
# اُسْتُظْرِفْنَا (ustuẓrifnā) /us.tuðˤ.rif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَظْرَفَ (istaẓrafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
